target_customer: Outpatient physical therapy practices billing Medicare for remote therapeutic monitoring
problem: Practices leave RTM revenue unclaimed because enrollment, monitoring, documentation and billing are burdensome.
business_model: Revenue share on RTM reimbursement with no upfront or fixed fees, per the company site
product_category: Remote therapeutic monitoring service for physical therapy

founders.name: Joanne Wang
education: NYU, Computing and Data Science and Finance
founders.background_notes: Education and employers from a launch post for a later company, as summarized from the YC page. A search snippet names Tommy Guo as co-founder, but the Copper Health YC page lists only Joanne Wang, so he is not recorded.

competitors.name: Limber Health
competitors.what: Remote monitoring and home exercise for musculoskeletal care
competitors.traction_then: Named as a 2022 digital health rising star

technical_complexity.rationale: Text message engagement plus billing documentation is standard software; the hard part is Medicare billing rules rather than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many RTM vendors existed and a services plus billing wrapper is easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy was found; CMS introduced RTM billing codes in 2022 and many vendors serve them.

market_need_then: CMS created RTM billing codes in 2022, giving practices a new reimbursable service; the company claims about $150 added revenue per patient per month, which is unverified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Practical and partner oriented; calls itself an RTM partner, not another subscription.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name, a .co domain, and a trademark record for COPPER HEALTH owned by another entity appeared in search; no press on the brand.

pivots.to: Copper Health, RTM for physical therapy
pivots.why: Reported in search results and a YC profile mention; the reason is not stated.

outcome_analysis: Copper Health is listed active with a two person team and eight named practice partners on its site, but no verified funding or traction metrics were found. The founder has since started another YC company (Epsilab, F26), which may signal Copper Health is no longer her main focus, though no source states this.
notes: An aggregator lists $500K seed from Y Combinator only, unverified and not recorded as a round. Pivot from Airfront comes from a search summary, not an opened primary page. Limber Health dated from a 2022 listing. Completeness pass: $500K accelerator round dated 2024-01-01 recorded from a directory citing PitchBook, with Standout and VCBacked also listing $500K seed from Y Combinator; no other investor or round named. Likely the standard YC deal. One search summary called Tommy Guo co-founder and CTO, but the YC page opened again lists only Joanne Wang, so no founder added.
